title: Operation "Spamouflage": China-linked influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the PRC-origin operation "Spamouflage", using AI to research social media activity, generate posts, and debug a previously unreported website.
body: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the PRC-origin operation "Spamouflage", using AI to research social media activity, generate posts, and debug a previously unreported website.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布报告称，已封禁与名为“Spamouflage”的中国相关虚假信息行动有关的账户。这些账户利用AI技术在社交媒体上生成内容、进行研究并调试网站。此举展示了AI大模型在被恶意利用进行舆论操纵时的风险，以及模型厂商在安全合规与内容治理方面的持续投入。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI披露了针对大模型滥用进行虚假信息传播的监测与封禁行动，反映了行业对模型安全治理的重视。
